overview: Mauritius offers postgraduate engineering options in areas such as civil engineering, building services, sustainable energy and renewable energy systems. Two institutions worth exploring are the University of Mauritius (UoM) and Université des Mascareignes (UdM). The right choice depends on your undergraduate specialisation, career goals and preferred study mode. Students planning to **Study Master’s in Engineering in Mauritius** should compare the available programmes and their entry requirements before applying.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Postgraduate Engineering in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Postgraduate Engineering in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Postgraduate Engineering in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
